commentary: Market breadth at 45 under a CAUTION gate demands strict adherence to O'Neil's market-direction discipline: capital preservation comes first when broad indices falter. Stan Weinstein taught that Stage 2 advances rarely overcome widespread distribution, while Jesse Livermore stressed sitting tight when macroeconomic crosswinds emerge. With October retail inflation rising to 6.09% and crude pressing 95 dollars, institutional sponsorship is highly defensive and selective. Minervini's progressive exposure rule commands patience; fresh equity exposure must be withheld or kept minimal until confirmed follow-through days emerge. We prioritize pristine Stage 2 bases showing tight volume contraction and verifiable earnings acceleration, enforcing rapid stops on any pattern breakdown.
